title: Mercantile occupancy codes
text:
Mercantile occupancy codes

Touchstone
 supports the following mercantile
 occupancy class codes.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and
 limitations for specific models, refer to the model documentation that is available on
 the 
Client Portal
.

Note:
 The associated 2-digit Standard Industrial
 Classification (SIC) code or codes are listed for each occupancy code.

| Occupancy code | Category | SIC2-digit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 335 | Gasoline Stations | 55 | Retail establishments selling gasoline for use in motor vehicles,
 including associated retail stores and service bays. Valid for all exposures
 in the U.S., South America, Australia, Canada, the Caribbean, Japan, South
 Korea, China, and Taiwan, and for exposures covered for wind in Europe. In
 other regions, use commercial occupancy code 312 for gasoline
 stations. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand . |
| 336 | Automotive Repair Shops and Car Washes | 75 | Includes car washes and motor vehicle repair and service businesses that
 do not also sell gasoline. If the repair service is part of a gasoline
 station, with gasoline pumps under a canopy, use mercantile occupancy code 335 . Valid
 for all exposures in the U.S., South America, Australia, Canada, the
 Caribbean, Japan, South Korea, China, and Taiwan, and for exposures covered
 for wind in Europe. In other regions, use commercial occupancy code 314 for these
 occupancies. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand . |

Automotive Repair Shops and Car Washes

Includes car washes and motor vehicle repair and service businesses that
                        do not also sell gasoline. If the repair service is part of a gasoline
                        station, with gasoline pumps under a canopy, use mercantile occupancy code 335 . Valid
                        for all exposures in the U.S., South America, Australia, Canada, the
                        Caribbean, Japan, South Korea, China, and Taiwan, and for exposures covered
                        for wind in Europe. In other regions, use commercial occupancy code 314 for these
                        occupancies. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand .
